description: Retargeted autoresearch to first_show_ms with the same anti-overfitting multi-scenario fresh-process harness; established new first-show baseline after import-surface wins.

Reduced first_show cold path by making display.py imports lazy: defer cli/context, icon_set, core writer, Block, and shape_lens imports until needed inside show(). Preserves behavior while significantly lowering show_import and improving first_show.
Tried importing shape_lens from .views.lens.shape directly to avoid lens package re-export imports on first show call; no primary gain and first_show regressed, so discarded.

Refactored show() to avoid importing CLI context/types on the first render path: normalize format by value/string locally, use a tiny local context detector (ANSI + width), and import shape_lens directly from views.lens.shape. Preserves behavior while cutting first_show_ms and module load substantially.

Further reduced first_show by making display.py module import lighter: defer shutil and nullcontext imports to runtime call sites. Restored show_import_ms while improving first_show_ms again; targeted show tests still pass.

Reduced first_show lens cold-path overhead by importing chart_lens/tree_lens in shape_lens only when those dispatch branches are selected (numeric/hierarchical data). For simple dict payloads this avoids extra lens module imports; show/lens tests pass.
Tried faster format normalization in display._format_value with direct str/value checks to reduce enum handling overhead; first_show_ms regressed versus current best.
Control rerun to gauge variance after prior keep. Metrics stayed above best; no change retained.
Tried single-pass dict auto-dispatch in shape_lens (combine labeled-numeric/hierarchical checks) to reduce helper calls. Behavior/tests OK but first_show_ms regressed versus best.
Tried removing hasattr guard from show context detection (use sys.stdout.isatty directly). No primary improvement; discarded.
Tried plain-format fast path in _detect_show_context (skip isatty when force_plain). Slightly better than recent variants but still above best first_show_ms.
Tried skipping ASCII icon scope for default shape_lens plain path (only apply icon override for custom lens). No primary gain and memory secondary worsened; discarded.
Added singleton-dict fast path in shape_lens _render_dict for zoom>=2 to avoid generic list/max setup on first_show payload shape; benchmark still regressed from best.

Avoid importing Block for common builtin payloads in show(): guard Block passthrough behind a builtin-type fast check so dict/list/scalar first-show paths skip block module import and isinstance work. Keeps Block passthrough behavior for non-builtin objects; show tests pass.

Simplified plain-render icon handling in show(): for default shape_lens path, skip icon context entirely; only apply use_icons(ASCII_ICONS) when caller passes a custom lens in plain mode. Reduced first_show overhead while preserving custom-lens plain behavior; show tests pass.
Control rerun after latest keep to validate stability; metric remained close but above best, so no new keep.
Inlined format normalization inside show() (removed helper call) to reduce call overhead; no primary gain and slight regression, discarded.
Attempted style constant reuse in shape_lens introduced accidental stray expression at module tail causing NameError during first_show import path. Fixed by removing stray line before next run.
Post-revert control rerun to re-anchor variance around current best branch state; remained slightly above best.
No-code rerun produced a lower sample likely from run-to-run noise/system variance. Discarded to avoid treating measurement noise as a real optimization.
Final control run in this 15-run batch; landed above best and confirms current kept changes remain the durable improvement set.
